+  it('c.redirect() percent-encodes raw CR/LF to prevent header injection', () => {
+    const res = c.redirect('/destination\r\nX-Injected: true')
+    expect(res.status).toBe(302)
+    expect(res.headers.get('Location')).toBe('/destination%0D%0AX-Injected: true')
+    expect(res.headers.get('X-Injected')).toBeNull()
+  })

+    const res = c.redirect('/destination\rX-Injected: true')
+    expect(res.headers.get('Location')).toBe('/destination%0DX-Injected: true')
+  })
+
+  it('c.redirect() percent-encodes a raw LF', () => {
+    const res = c.redirect('/destination\nX-Injected: true')
+    expect(res.headers.get('Location')).toBe('/destination%0AX-Injected: true')
+  })
+
+  it('c.redirect() leaves percent-encoded CR/LF sequences unchanged', () => {
+    for (const location of [
+      '/destination%0D%0AX-Injected: true',
+      '/destination%0d%0aX-Injected: true',
+    ]) {
+      const res = c.redirect(location)
+      expect(res.headers.get('Location')).toBe(location)
+    }
+  })
+
